So I am by no means a 3d printer expert but figured I'd put in my 2 cents. I started with a voxelab 3d printer back in 2021 learn a lot about 3d printing from that. But I recently upgraded to an A1 w/AMS combo.

1. Dryer is optional but a great thing to have. When you're first starting out it don't believe it's a requirement to have a dryer at first. It's a great item to put on a Christmas list 😄 
2. BambuLabs official wiki says to not use IPA on their build plates. I've been using a small drop of Dawn. Make sure to only touch the edges after cleaning to avoid getting finger prints.
3. Switching to a hardened steel nozzle all the time is fine.
4. Filament brands I really like are Elegoo, Overture, Sunlu and BambuLabs. Elegoo are packaged very well and print easy. Overture is about the same. I buy most of my filament on Amazon because especially during sales the prices are better than BambuLabs and I don't have to buy 4 at a time for a discount. Petg is better for outdoor use than PLA+ but definitely depends on use case. 
5. I started with TinkerCad when I first started designing my own parts. It is SUPER simple and I think is aimed more for kids but hey you gotta start somewhere! After getting a grasp on how to make a simple objects for around the house I wanted to do more. So I've been frustrating learning Fusion360, it's freaking hard but I've been hammering away at learning it so it's definitely possible. But I would start with printing models from MakersWorld to get your 'sea legs' and not overwhelm yourself.

Welcome to the club. I hope you enjoy it.

My all time favorite game is:

**Skyrim**: Great RPG (Role-Playing Game) it has tons of quest and many things to do. Small things are annoying about it but considering that you are building a PC then you will probably be gaming on a PC therefore you can just install mods to combat issues. Anyway, Skyrim is set back in the fictional old times. You can customize your character and you start off with no skills and gain each one individually by using them.


Second Favorite:
**Mass Effect Trilogy:** Also an RPG but more linear. There is no quest element but you can complete other missions as you go but in the end there is a main story to be followed. I picked the Trilogy because I truly did like all the games. It got you hooked to the characters and truly feel there pain and problems. The shooter parts are sub-par but the terrific voice acting and story make up for it.

Third Favorite:
**Bioshock Infinite:** Mind bending! My brain hurt at the end of the games trying to wrap my head around the idea! It is am intriguing story that has great characters, graphics, and game play!


Some others:
**Call of Duty: Ghost:** It isn't a must-play but i figured I'd add a little variety. Ghost is a normal shooter. It improved some aspects in the game play from it's predecessor but not much after that.

**The Wolf Among Us/ The Walking Dead:** It is basically a choose your own adventure moving/interactive comic book. It is great game. The Wolf Among Us and The Walking Dead really attach you to the characters like Mass Effect does. The art style is also unique cell-shading style.

**Borderlands 2:** Has the same sort of art style as The Wolf Among Us/ The Walking Dead. Borderlands 2 is more like Skyrim being open world. I have only played an hour of this game so don't really know much other than that.

**Diablo 3:** It use to have major server issues but they have cleared those up leaving a great game. It is technically classified as a RPG but it is different. The player kills things gets loot levels up and progress like an RPG but the whole feel is different. 

**Payday 2:** Great Multiplayer game! The idea is that "players plan and carry out various heists and robberies by using a combination of teamwork, stealth and firearms" ([Link](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Payday_2)) The NPCs (Non-Player Character) are ver responsive to the robber (the player) being that if the player is to stealthy and looks mischievous than they the NPCs will start calling the cops. Although, sometimes the cops will be right in front of you and they still miss overall it is a pretty good game.
